boundaryChecks.boundary: Operator export input to isolated uploaded Vite execution
boundaryChecks.reason: Mac reads ZIP/data and invokes only repository-owned bundles and fixed Lima argv. Archive extraction precedes materialization and is followed by per-file path/hash/size checks inside Linux. Uploaded Vite/config is executed only under the retained wcb-runner systemd/bwrap boundary, cleared environment, read-only runtime/profile mounts and private tmp/proc/network namespaces. No public gateway command reaches these operator-installed TEST workers. No attacker-controlled shell string or Mac code/config execution sink identified.

Profile names are fixed allowlisted values, input package/lock paths derive from the repository, and npm ci uses --ignore-scripts. Privileged, network-enabled preparation is separate operator authority and receives no uploaded package/config. Destination replacement is refused. No new remote attacker path to this administrative operation was found.

Fixed subject names select operator-generated local artifacts; a separate fixed worker is installed without editing normal worker/launch.sh. Chromium native namespace/seccomp sandbox is required. Browser egress continues into the isolated network namespace, not an editor-side fetch. Diagnostic timeouts and pipe/resource limits are bounded; regular product screenshot acceptance remains unchanged.

boundaryChecks.boundary: TEST TLS, identity and gateway credentials
boundaryChecks.reason: Helper binds TEST listeners to loopback, creates short-lived certs in an owner-only working directory, writes private config/mTLS key files at 0600, and uses verified/pinned TLS. Platform-browser cookies are restricted to the platform host. Normal close removes enumerated private files. No credential literal, project mount of credentials or export inclusion is introduced.

boundaryChecks.boundary: Original corpus and full application QA on the Mac
boundaryChecks.reason: Git object/archive commands are fixed argv; provenance hashes and canonical database source bytes are compared. Mac browser visits the packaged platform UI and trusted raster iframe; upstream JavaScript is never browser-loaded on the Mac by these scripts. Static inspect/compile uses the platform engine; that engine internals are assigned to the parent/core reviewer.

boundaryChecks.boundary: Queued raster input to current source and runner authority
boundaryChecks.reason: A mode toggle no longer starts an unnecessary capture. Stale queued pointers rebind only for exact nonempty PNG equality and equal generation/revision/route/viewport, with queue epoch/revision/generation checks. The trusted iframe message must match source window, null origin, channel, current generation and current sequence; HTTP input still requires a positive sequence, current source, capability/session binding and fresh authorization. PNG equality does not claim hidden DOM-state equality and supplies no new source-authoring authority.

policyResolution.result: All resolver calls returned empty policy with exit 0. No SECURITY.md exclusions were invented.

limitations: Read-only source review only: no runtime execution, tests, PoCs, upstream configuration execution, external requests, registry/advisory lookup or credential-file content reads were performed.

No whole-repository, production deployment or operating-system enforcement attestation is implied. Engine intake/config/dependency admission internals and locks are separately assigned to the parent/core reviewer.

QA lifecycle cleanup is not total for setup failure before helper return or malformed receipt processing before stop; private owner-only TEST state may need operator cleanup. No remote read/exfiltration path or persistent cross-tenant impact was established, so this is recorded as an operational limitation rather than a security candidate.

Independent export worker and uploaded config share a disposable Linux execution job. Returned QA fields are useful evidence for fixed selected applications, not a cryptographic integrity guarantee against deliberately hostile configuration attempting to falsify that same job; no authority is granted to a remote caller based on these receipts.
Exact raster PNG equality permits visually identical frames and does not prove equal hidden DOM/app state. Source mutation still requires a later authorized action and source identity validation.

Operator profile preparation deliberately has administrative network authority, unlike the subsequent uploaded-source job. The review did not inspect package registry advisory status or privileged environment contents.
Supplemental file digests identify the exact read versions; later changes require a further bounded reread.

measuredUsage.note: This worker has no per-scan token or tool-budget measurement interface; no usage value is invented.
